name: Visvam Srinivasan
belief: I believe the best work comes from being curious, staying kind, and caring about the details.
artCaption: A little intention goes a long way.
intro: I make useful things for the web, with a focus on clear thinking and thoughtful details.
about: I’m a multidisciplinary creative who enjoys turning complicated ideas into simple, useful experiences. My work sits somewhere between design, technology, and a healthy curiosity about how things work.

Over the past few years, I’ve partnered with kind people and ambitious teams to make products that feel considered, work beautifully, and make a real difference. Outside of work, you’ll find me collecting books, taking long walks, or trying a new recipe.
